coverage.summary: Pending House bill on algorithmic rent fixing in the rental housing market. The bill page gives only the title, committee and actions, so the covered buildings, units and owners are not stated.

evidence.quoted_span: An Act relative to preventing algorithmic rent fixing in the rental housing market

result.notes: D045 contains only the bill title, the committee (House Ways and Means) and an action list that references H1564. It has no operative text, so every coverage field except the summary stays null. D046 and D047 describe S.2983, a separate Senate bill, and do not supply coverage for H.5222. D048 (c. 40P rent control ban with its 10-unit owner threshold) and the Cella opinion and coverage of Initiative Petition 25-21 (owner-occupied four or fewer units, new construction under 10 years) concern different measures and must not be imported. The remaining documents are unrelated general laws.
